name: Higuera de las Dueñas (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Higuera de las Dueñas (a fig tree with a crozier on red).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 12 March 2000 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 83 of 2 May 2002); the flag is square of proportion 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms in their colours at the centre.

features.role: Higuera de las Dueñas arms — fig tree with crozier on red
